doctrine.name: The First-Touch Doctrine
doctrine.thesis: The enemy of CardioShield is not the comparator molecule. It is the ritual of delay — the 'stabilise first' habit that postpones guideline therapy past the only moment that reliably converts. Lead the campaign with first-eligible / in-hospital initiation. PIONEER-HF (2019) shows that starting after haemodynamic stabilisation is feasible; ESC/ACC Class I plus PARADIGM-HF are the outcome permission — not a reason to wait for a second clinic visit.
doctrine.bet: Every eligible first encounter is the guideline encounter.
doctrine.whyNovel: Most launch decks sell a better drug. This doctrine retires a clinical habit. Validated citations — not a slogan — decide what we are allowed to lead with.

slides.title: Five moves that retire the ritual
slides.narrative: Each move is the execution of a cited finding — not a separate creative idea. If the science row cannot name the intervention, the intervention does not ship.
bullets: First-Touch Protocol — A hospital-to-clinic initiation bundle so CardioShield is started at the first eligible encounter.  [PIONEER-HF 2019 · PMID 30415601 · doi:10.1056/NEJMoa1812851]
Affordability Confidence Kit — A field-legal script, PAP mechanics, and HE one-pager that lets the HCP stay on the patient's side.  [Trivandrum HFR 2015 · PMID 26011246 · doi:10.1002/ejhf.283]
Myth-Reset Asset — One wrong belief, one local number, one peer voice. Unlearning, not a lecture.  [Jhund 2015 age · PMID 26231885 · doi:10.1093/eurheartj/ehv330]
Peer Cascade — Metro KOLs author the protocol; tier-2 peers demonstrate it. Cover travels down, not out as a TV ad.  [ESC 2021 Class I · PMID 34447992 · doi:10.1093/eurheartj/ehab368]
Habit-Lock CRM — The second prescription is designed, not hoped for. Prompts, feedback, peer norms.  [PARADIGM-HF 2014 · PMID 25176015 · doi:10.1056/NEJMoa1409077]

slides.title: Impact against friction — the Q1 mix is not the year mix
slides.narrative: Q1 buys proof of mechanism: one hospital pathway, one cost kit, one myth-reset asset. Q2–Q4 scale what moved a driver.

slides.title: A single HCP should feel a designed sequence, not a spray
slides.narrative: Pre-launch builds peer cover. Launch installs the first-touch protocol. Adoption locks the habit. Beyond the campaign, the pathway stays.

chart.title: Designed contact cadence (per priority HCP / quarter)

slides.title: Activation is a specialty × status × city × cost grid — then we collapse it
slides.narrative: Six segments carry the year. The rest inherit. Cost-concern is a design input, not a footnote.

rows: Referral trigger, not a full GDMT lesson

slides.title: Revenue is the parent metric. Everything else must explain it.
slides.narrative: Leading indicators (protocol use, kit use, myth-score) have to move before volume. If they do not, we kill the tactic — we do not add a new one.

slides.title: Risks, dependencies, MLR — the unglamorous slide that saves the year

callout.label: CardioShield
callout.text: Lead the campaign with first-eligible / in-hospital initiation. PIONEER-HF (2019) shows that starting after haemodynamic stabilisation is feasible; ESC/ACC Class I plus PARADIGM-HF are the outcome permission — not a reason to wait for a second clinic visit.

interventions.name: First-Touch Protocol
interventions.promise: A hospital-to-clinic initiation bundle so CardioShield is started at the first eligible encounter.
interventions.mlr: Protocol language must match label and local code. No start-all implication.
interventions.kill: If discharge initiation rate is unchanged at week 8 in the pilot site.

interventions.name: Affordability Confidence Kit
interventions.promise: A field-legal script, PAP mechanics, and HE one-pager that lets the HCP stay on the patient's side.
interventions.segment: Tier-2 consultants and high OOP caseloads
interventions.mlr: No price promises. Assistance, not inducement.
interventions.kill: If PAP mention rate rises but initiation does not.

interventions.name: Myth-Reset Asset
interventions.promise: One wrong belief, one local number, one peer voice. Unlearning, not a lecture.
interventions.mlr: Comparative safety claims need the source grade on-slide.
interventions.kill: If unaided myth prevalence does not drop in the next insight wave.

interventions.name: Peer Cascade
interventions.promise: Metro KOLs author the protocol; tier-2 peers demonstrate it. Cover travels down, not out as a TV ad.
interventions.kill: If cascade stops at the same five names by Q2.

interventions.name: Habit-Lock CRM
interventions.promise: The second prescription is designed, not hoped for. Prompts, feedback, peer norms.
interventions.mlr: CRM content is promotional and goes through MLR.
interventions.kill: If repeat rate among trialists is flat vs control geographies.
